name: licenkit
description: LicenKit - Modern, self-hosted API-First licensing hub and key generator
author: LicenKit Contributors

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @licenkit/checkout run build && pnpm --filter @licenkit/cli run build && node scripts/run-site.mjs build && pnpm --filter @licenkit/admin run build && pnpm --filter @licenkit/server run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @licenkit/checkout run typecheck && pnpm --filter @licenkit/cli run typecheck && node scripts/run-site.mjs typecheck && pnpm --filter @licenkit/admin run typecheck && pnpm --filter @licenkit/server run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @licenkit/server run test && pnpm --filter @licenkit/cli run test && pnpm --filter @licenkit/checkout run test && node scripts/run-site.mjs test && pnpm --filter @licenkit/admin run test
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @licenkit/server run deploy
